Behind the brochure

A joke with a paper trail.

This is a neighbor’s parody project about the experience of living beside short-term rentals. The nicknames and travel-brochure copy are satire; the guest reviews and documentation are presented with their sources and limits.

Neither page is a rental listing. This project is not affiliated with Airbnb, Booking.com, any property owner, or the Grand Theft Auto franchise. Parody illustrations should not be mistaken for photographs of actual events.
